scores.evidence: Phase 1. Doc loading, search, test harness ... Phase 2. Answer generation, safeguards, handoff, logging
scores.rationale: Order is broadly substrate-up (data, retrieval, generation, rollout), but safeguards and logging arrive in Phase 2 and the test set precedes any system.

scores.evidence: 0. Coverage audit, test set, choose the stack
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is an audit and planning phase with no end-to-end production path; first user-facing slice is a beta at phase 4.

scores.evidence: Only let the model run its own searches ("agentic" retrieval) if tests show multi-part questions failing.
scores.rationale: There are defaults with some flip conditions (agentic, contextual retrieval, build vs buy), but no consolidated irreversible-decision list and many assumptions stay implicit.

scores.evidence: Index only public articles, or store the permissions and filter on them. Leaking internal-only articles is the most common failure here.
scores.rationale: Some wide-impact items (permissions, deletes, chunking) are emphasised, but there is no explicit blast-radius ordering within phases.

scores.evidence: Phase 2 ... Test targets met, security review passed
scores.rationale: Security is covered concretely in a standalone section and some ingestion details, but phase-tied security mainly lands in Phase 2 and not in earlier phases.

scores.evidence: Phase 2. Answer generation, safeguards, handoff, logging
scores.rationale: Logging and tracing are detailed but first scheduled in Phase 2, not day zero; the test harness in Phase 1 gives partial coverage.

scores.evidence: Keep prompts in version control. ... log the ... prompt, index and model versions
scores.rationale: Prompt versioning, version logging and automated eval on changes exist, but no reproducible environment, build or data-snapshot treatment across phases.

scores.evidence: nightly reconcile, incl. deletes ... replace it with a safe fallback message and offer a human.
scores.rationale: Failure handling (fallbacks, handoff, reconcile) is present but not tied to phases, with no provider outage, retry or timeout treatment.

scores.evidence: Run the tests automatically on every change ... Rate-limit per session and IP address, cap conversation length, and cap daily spending.
scores.rationale: Retrieval→generation ordering is sound and handoff and budgets exist, but defenses, budgets and human-in-the-loop are built in Phase 2 alongside generation, not clearly before capabilities.

scores.evidence: Later (v2): have a vision model describe key screenshots
scores.rationale: Several deferrals are named (v2 vision, forums excluded, account lookups, agentic retrieval), but pull-forward conditions are only sporadic and there is no deferred list.

note: Strong RAG content and evaluation discipline, but it is phased as audit-then-build with no production walking skeleton, and security, observability and resilience are not threaded from Phase 0.
